reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Implement `flux [reconcile|suspend|resume] image policy` commands by @lukas8219 in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5492", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: New CLI capability only: `flux [reconcile|suspend|resume] image policy` commands become available in the flux CLI; the evidence states no change to existing behavior and no operational consequence for an operator who does nothing.

proposed.statement: Flux 2.7.0 implements new `flux [reconcile|suspend|resume] image policy` CLI commands (reconcile, suspend and resume for image policy).
